Historic milestones were highlighted, including the women's hockey team breaking a forty-four-year gold medal drought, victories in cricket, kabaddi, archery, shooting, boxing, wrestling, sailing, soft tennis, and mixed martial arts. Reaffirming national goals, the address declared ambitions to host the 2030 Commonwealth Games and the 2036 Olympic Games while fostering a global sporting hub.
